scope: Gremlin traversals RushDB accepts as text and as GraphSON 3 bytecode. Every traversal here runs on the engine (crates/rushdb-language/tests/gremlin_profile.rs) and is valid under the official TinkerPop grammar (CI gremlin-grammar, scripts/validate-gremlin-grammar.sh). Bytecode cases also pin their translation.
fixture: Person vertices alice (29), bob (27), carol (32), dave (35); KNOWS alice->bob, alice->carol, carol->dave; CREATED alice->lop, carol->lop where lop is Software (lang java)
